- 音乐收藏不用再选文件夹：在设置里把分类选成「音乐收藏」，栏目就会出现，直接粘贴网易云、QQ 音乐歌单或 YouTube 链接即可，链接会自动保存。
  Music collection no longer needs a folder: set a category to "Music collection" and it appears right away, ready for pasted NetEase, QQ Music or YouTube links, which are saved automatically.
- 以前建了但没选文件夹的音乐栏目会自动修复，不会重复生成。
  Music categories created earlier without a folder are repaired automatically, without duplicates.
